hero.headline:
From Our Hands,
To Your Ritual.
hero.sub: Every order is carefully packed, quickly shipped, and fully tracked, so your ritual starts without delay.

steps.title: Order Confirmed
steps.desc: Your ritual begins. We verify your order and prepare it for fulfillment within hours.

steps.title: Carefully Packed
steps.desc: Each device is inspected, wrapped in protective packaging, and sealed with care in our European warehouse.

steps.title: In Transit
steps.desc: Your parcel is handed to our trusted logistics partner. Real time tracking is sent to your inbox.

steps.title: Out for Delivery
steps.desc: Your package is on its way to your door. Our carriers deliver 6 days a week across Europe.

steps.title: Delivered
steps.desc: Your ritual arrives. Unbox, explore, and begin your first 5 minute session today.

zones.title: Where We Ship.
zones.footnote: International orders may be subject to customs duties and import taxes.

items.title: Insured Shipments
items.desc: Every parcel is fully insured against damage or loss during transit.

items.title: Same Day Processing
items.desc: Orders placed before 2 PM CET ship the same business day.

items.title: Global Reach
items.desc: We deliver to 50+ countries with reliable international carriers.

items.title: Eco Packaging
items.desc: Recyclable materials and minimal waste, because rituals should be mindful.

cta.headline: Questions about your order?
cta.sub: Our support team responds within 24–48 hours.
